description: Research Experiences for Undergraduates (REU), NSF NHERI 2024: Evaluating the Free Surface Interactions of Tsunami-like Waves with a Structural Column is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Lucy Hegenderfer, California Polytechnic State University San Luis Obispo (calpoly.edu). This project focuses on the change in free surface elevation of solitary and transient waves in relation to wave progression and structure interaction. This data can be reused to observe wave changes as it interacts with a square structure and can be used to further investigate additional wave types and heights by comparison. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project with 3 top-level files (PDF). Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-f4c9-nm43. Keywords: NSF NHERI OSU HWRL, solitary waves, transient waves, square structure interaction, free surface elevation, scour. Published 2024-08-28. Facility named: O.H. Hinsdale Wave Research Laboratory, Oregon State University. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0 (labelled "Creative Commons Attribution" on the DesignSafe project). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
